arrive.title: SHIMMER
arrive.sub: every level is a star to place

map.title: STAR MAP
map.full: Every star in it is placed
map.north: The North Star lights when all six are full
map.nextOne: Next perk with your next star

constellations.name: The Sunflower
constellations.each: Each star here: +1% XP in the park

perks.name: Seeds stay cheap
perks.line: In the park, seeds stay cheaper as your garden grows: the price goes up half as fast for every plant you have.

perks.name: Green thumb
perks.line: In the park, your crops need one day less of watering before they are ready to pick.

perks.name: Two seeds
perks.line: In the park, every harvest gives you two seeds for your homestead garden instead of one.

perks.name: Rare birds
perks.line: In the park, rarer birds come out for you, so you spot new kinds sooner.

perks.name: Ripe for longer
perks.line: In the park, your ripe plants wait a day longer before the park composts them, so you still get the seed or flower.

perks.name: Deep roots
perks.line: In the park, your plants last two more days without water before they wilt.

perks.name: Water them all
perks.line: In the park, one tap waters every thirsty plant within your reach, not just one.

perks.name: Storm-proof
perks.line: In the park, storms never rot your plants. Today a storm rots about half of them.

perks.name: Extra fruit
perks.line: In the park, your strawberries and grapes give fruit four times instead of three.

perks.name: Watering pays
perks.line: In the park, watering your own plants pays the same XP as watering someone else’s, and each one blooms as you water it.

perks.name: The Sunflower
perks.line: In the park, your watered crops grow twice as fast, and every harvest of yours bursts into starlight for all to see.

constellations.name: The Hen
constellations.each: Each star here: +1% XP at your homestead

perks.name: Express van
perks.line: At your homestead, everything you order on the Banana Phone or from Pip’s shelf arrives by van in half the time.

perks.name: Early sprout
perks.line: At your homestead, crops are ready a day sooner, because planting counts as their first watering.

perks.name: Walk-by hugs
perks.line: At your homestead, your animals get their hug when you walk past them, so you never have to tap each one.

perks.name: Goods wait for you
perks.line: At your homestead, eggs and milk keep piling up for two more days while you are away.

perks.name: Babies grow fast
perks.line: At your homestead, baby animals grow up after three fed mornings instead of five.

perks.name: Full trough
perks.line: At your homestead, one fill keeps the trough full for two mornings, so a day away still gets you double goods.

perks.name: Pie lasts longer
perks.line: At your homestead, pumpkin pie gives double XP for twice as long, and it works in every area.

perks.name: Good neighbour
perks.line: At a neighbour’s homestead, your watering counts as two, so their crops are ready sooner.

perks.name: Double hearts
perks.line: At your homestead, every hug gives an animal two hearts instead of one, so it levels up twice as fast.

perks.name: One more animal
perks.line: At your homestead, your pens hold one more hen, goat, sheep and cow.

perks.name: The Hen
perks.line: At your homestead, your dog or cat learns to come along: it follows you into every area, where everyone can see it.

constellations.name: The Ghost
constellations.each: Each star here: +1% XP in Banana Town

perks.name: Calm ghosts
perks.line: In Banana Town, ghosts stop running away when you come close, so they are much easier to catch.

perks.name: Quick fix
perks.line: In Banana Town, a broken street lamp or arcade cabinet takes you less than half as long to mend.

perks.name: Strong arms
perks.line: In Banana Town, carrying a crate or a parcel no longer slows you down.

perks.name: Tomorrow’s orders
perks.line: In Banana Town, Tally’s Exchange shows tomorrow’s three orders as well as today’s, so you can gather ahead.

perks.name: More to fix
perks.line: In Banana Town, a third more problems turn up for you to fix.

perks.name: Steady hands
perks.line: In Banana Town, the café and lemonade stand stay just as easy to time all shift, and post office cards wait longer.

perks.name: Ghost tamer
perks.line: In Banana Town, the shy drifting ghost no longer hides from you, so you can catch it too.

perks.name: Second spin
perks.line: In Banana Town, the Wheel of Peel gives you two free spins a day instead of one.

perks.name: Ghost bounty
perks.line: In Banana Town, every ghost after the day’s first pays double XP.

perks.name: Ghost fireworks
perks.line: In Banana Town, the day’s first ghost you catch pays double XP and sets off a firework with your name over the square.

perks.name: The Ghost
perks.line: In Banana Town, at night a friendly ghost floats beside you and catches the ghosts that come near you.

constellations.name: The Fish
constellations.each: Each star here: +1% XP at Banana Bay

perks.name: Quick bite
perks.line: At Banana Bay, fish bite in half the time, so you catch more every time you sit down to fish.

perks.name: Beachcomber
perks.line: At Banana Bay, shells wash up a third faster, and ten can lie on the sand at once instead of eight.

perks.name: Catch of the day
perks.line: At Banana Bay, your first fish every day is uncommon or rarer, never a common one.

perks.name: Sea legs
perks.line: At Banana Bay, the lagoon no longer slows you down: you wade through the water at full speed.

perks.name: Lucky line
perks.line: At Banana Bay, rare and legendary fish bite a quarter more often, day and night.

perks.name: Night fishing
perks.line: At Banana Bay, rare and legendary fish bite twice as often at night.

perks.name: Treasure sense
perks.line: At Banana Bay, map pieces turn up sooner, and the sand says you are close to the treasure from twice as far.

perks.name: Lure keeper
perks.line: At Banana Bay, a lure from the Wheel of Peel lasts eight bites instead of five.

perks.name: Big hitter
perks.line: At Banana Bay, your volleyball hits fly much higher, nearly as high as Sandy’s, so long rallies are easier.

perks.name: Starlit float
perks.line: At Banana Bay, when a rare or legendary fish bites, your float flashes with starlight and that catch pays double XP.

perks.name: The Fish
perks.line: At Banana Bay, you fish with two rods at once, so you get twice the bites, and everyone sees both lines.

constellations.name: The Vinyl
constellations.each: Each star here: +1% XP at the rave

perks.name: Jelly keeper
perks.line: At the rave, your jelly meter waits twice as long before it starts to drain, then drains half as fast.

perks.name: Longer JELLY TIME
perks.line: At the rave, JELLY TIME lasts half as long again, and so does the drop that comes with it.

perks.name: Jelly magnet
perks.line: At the rave, jelly near you floats to you, so you pick it up from twice as far.

perks.name: More reactions
perks.line: At the rave, you get two more reactions, confetti and a banana, and everyone on the floor sees them.

perks.name: Lucky jelly
perks.line: At the rave, rainbow jelly turns up half as often again, and gold jelly a third more often.

perks.name: More mega jelly
perks.line: At the rave, the mega jelly comes to you twice as often.

perks.name: Late to the party
perks.line: At the rave, you can still join a floor quest for twice as long after it starts.

perks.name: Laser sense
perks.line: At the rave, lasers warn you twice as early before they sweep the floor.

perks.name: Longer toys
perks.line: At the rave, the toys you grab from the conveyor last twice as long.

perks.name: Gold footprints
perks.line: At the rave, during JELLY TIME every jelly you pick up pays double XP, and your footprints glow gold for everyone.

perks.name: The Vinyl
perks.line: At the rave, once a day you can play the whole floor a bonus drop, with your name on the big screen.

constellations.name: The Banana
constellations.each: Each star here: your banana’s light grows

perks.name: Night stride
perks.line: At night, your banana walks a fifth faster, in every area where night falls.

perks.name: Long reach
perks.line: Everywhere but the rave, you pick things up from half again as far: litter, eggs, shells, flyers, ghosts and more.

perks.name: Where you left off
perks.line: Everywhere, going back to an area puts you where you last stood there, not at its gate.

perks.name: Sugar rush
perks.line: Everywhere but the rave, each pickup makes you a quarter faster for a few seconds, like the rave’s sugar rush.

perks.name: Lucky hands
perks.line: Everywhere, one thing in ten that you pick up counts twice for XP.

perks.name: Night owl
perks.line: At night, you earn a quarter more XP, in every area where night falls.

perks.name: Day stride
perks.line: By day too, your banana walks a tenth faster, everywhere except the rave.

perks.name: Longer reach
perks.line: Everywhere but the rave, you pick things up from twice as far away, instead of half again.

perks.name: Warm wave
perks.line: Everywhere, each wave you send pays you and the player you wave to 25 XP, once a day for each player.

perks.name: Night sprint
perks.line: At night, your banana walks a third faster, instead of a fifth.

perks.name: The Banana
perks.line: Everywhere, each new Shimmer level makes you shine with starlight for a few minutes, with double XP while you shine.

north.name: The North Star
north.line: When all six signs are full, a star in Banana Town’s night sky is named after you, for everyone, for good.
